args.query: expired client certificate mTLS bank partner payment failures

events.statement: payment-service HTTP 5xx error_rate stayed flat at ~0.22% across 11:00-13:59Z, matching the report that the error-rate dashboard is green.
payment-service bank_api_error_rate was ~0.2% until 12:00Z, then rose to 75% at 12:12Z and 100% from 12:24Z onward.
payment-service payment_success_rate collapsed from ~99% to 26.8% at 12:12Z and ~2.5% from 12:24Z onward.
cert-watcher logged at 11:50:26Z that client certificate CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal expires in 25 minutes at notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z.
From 12:15:27Z payment-service logged 140 'marked PENDING_RETRY: mTLS handshake with bank-partner-api rejected' errors, first-seen 12:15:27Z.

payment-service logged 171 'bank-partner-api call failed: remote error: tls: expired certificate (alert 45); our client cert CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal notAfter=2026-04-02T12:15:00Z' errors, first-seen 12:16:44Z.
payment-service latency_p99_ms actually DROPPED from ~320ms to ~140ms at 12:12Z (failing fast on TLS rejection), not increased.
payment-service request_rate stayed flat at ~100 req/s through the whole window; no traffic surge.
api-gateway error_rate (~0.21%) and latency_p99_ms (~210ms) were completely flat through the incident, so the symptom is not visible at the edge.
payment-service cpu_pct was flat at ~30% and restarts were 0 across the window; db_pool_in_use was flat at ~8 connections.
No payment-service code deployment occurred; the only deploy in the window was settlement-service dep-5510 v1.9.0 at 10:30Z, which completed rollout with all pods ready.
The only config change was cfg-2502 on payment-service: bank.api.timeout_ms raised 3000->5000 at 11:20Z, ~55 min before onset.
settlement-service showed only GC-pause warnings (273ms/391ms) and normal INFO heartbeats; no failures aligned with the 12:15Z onset.
bank-partner-api is an external dependency with has_telemetry=false, so no direct vendor-side telemetry is available.

The failure mode is distinct from a partner-side outage: the log identifies OUR client cert (CN=payments-client.orangeinvest.internal) as the expired element, with the server responding 'alert 45' (certificate_expired).
payment 5xx counter is green because payment-service absorbs bank failures as PENDING_RETRY rather than returning HTTP errors, so the dashboard metric never fires.
